items.source: The classes in this package are discussed in Chapter 11 of Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development by Rod Johnson (Wrox, 2002).
items.translation: 本包中的类在 Rod Johnson 所著的《Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development》（Wrox, 2002）第 11 章中进行了讨论。 Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development

items.source:
A BeanWrapper object may be used to set and get bean properties,
singly or in bulk.
items.translation: BeanWrapper 对象可用于设置和获取单个或批量 Bean 属性。

items.source: Simple factory facade for obtaining PropertyAccessor instances, in particular for BeanWrapper instances.
items.translation: 用于获取PropertyAccessor实例的简单工厂门面，特别是用于BeanWrapper实例。

items.source: Editor for a PropertyValues object.
items.translation: Editor 用于 PropertyValues 对象。

items.source: BeanInfoFactory implementation that performs standard Introspector inspection.
items.translation: 实现 BeanInfoFactory 接口以执行标准的 Introspector 检查。

items.source: Extension of StandardBeanInfoFactory that supports "non-standard" JavaBeans setter methods through introspection by Spring's (package-visible) ExtendedBeanInfo implementation.
items.translation: 扩展了 `StandardBeanInfoFactory` 的类，它通过 Spring 的（包可见）`ExtendedBeanInfo` 实现支持“非标准”JavaBeans setter 方法的内省。

items.source: A basic ConfigurablePropertyAccessor that provides the necessary infrastructure for all typical use cases.
items.translation: 一个基本的ConfigurablePropertyAccessor，为所有典型用例提供必要的底层架构。

items.source: Abstract implementation of the PropertyAccessor interface.
items.translation: `PropertyAccessor` 接口的抽象实现。

items.source: Default BeanWrapper implementation that should be sufficient for all typical use cases.
items.translation: 默认 `BeanWrapper` 实现，足以满足所有典型用例。

items.source: ConfigurablePropertyAccessor implementation that directly accesses instance fields.
items.translation: 直接访问实例字段的 ConfigurablePropertyAccessor 实现。

items.source: Utility methods for classes that perform bean property access according to the PropertyAccessor interface.
items.translation: 用于执行根据PropertyAccessor接口定义的 Bean 属性访问的实用方法。

items.source: Base implementation of the PropertyEditorRegistry interface.
items.translation: `PropertyEditorRegistry` 接口（位于 `org.springframework.beans` 包中）的基实现。

items.source: Simple implementation of the TypeConverter interface that does not operate on a specific target object.
items.translation: 对 `TypeConverter` 接口的简单实现，该实现不针对特定目标对象进行操作。

items.source: Base implementation of the TypeConverter interface, using a package-private delegate.
items.translation: `TypeConverter` 接口的基实现，使用包级私有委托。

items.source: Extension of AttributeAccessorSupport, holding attributes as BeanMetadataAttribute objects in order to keep track of the definition source.
items.translation: `AttributeAccessorSupport` 的扩展，以 `BeanMetadataAttribute` 对象的形式存储属性，以便跟踪定义来源。

items.source: Interface for strategies that register custom property editors with a property editor registry.
items.translation: 用于向 属性编辑器注册表 注册自定义 属性编辑器 的策略接口。

items.source: Strategy interface for creating BeanInfo instances for Spring beans.
items.translation: 用于为 Spring bean 创建BeanInfo实例的策略接口。

items.source: Internal class that caches JavaBeans PropertyDescriptor information for a Java class.
items.translation: 内部类，用于缓存 Java 类的 JavaBeans PropertyDescriptor 信息。

items.source: The default implementation of the PropertyValues interface.
items.translation: PropertyValues接口的默认实现。

items.source: Encapsulates methods for registering JavaBeans PropertyEditors.
items.translation: 封装用于注册 JavaBeans PropertyEditors 的方法。

items.source: Holder containing one or more PropertyValue objects, typically comprising one update for a specific target bean.
items.translation: 包含一个或多个PropertyValue对象的容器，通常针对特定目标 Bean 包含一个更新。

items.source: The core package implementing Spring's lightweight Inversion of Control (IoC) container.
items.translation: 实现 Spring 轻量级控制反转（IoC）容器的核心包。

items.source:
Properties editors used to convert from String values to object
types such as java.util.Properties.
items.translation: 用于将字符串值转换为对象类型（如 java.util.Properties）的属性编辑器。

items.source:
Classes supporting the org.springframework.beans package,
such as utility classes for sorting and holding lists of beans.
items.translation: 支持 org.springframework.beans 包的类，例如用于排序和持有 Bean 列表的工具类。

items.source: A handler for a specific property.
items.translation: 特定属性的处理器。

items.source: Holder class used to store property tokens.
items.translation: 用于存储属性标记的 Holder 类。

items.source: Exception thrown when instantiation of a bean failed.
items.translation: 实例化 Bean 失败时抛出异常。

items.source: Holder for a key-value style attribute that is part of a bean definition.
items.translation: 包含作为 Bean 定义一部分的键值对风格属性的持有者。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by bean metadata elements
that carry a configuration source object.
items.translation: 由承载配置源对象的 Bean 元数据元素实现的接口。

items.source:
Abstract superclass for all exceptions thrown in the beans package
and subpackages.
items.translation: beans 包及其子包中抛出的所有异常的抽象父类。

items.source:
Static convenience methods for JavaBeans: for instantiating beans,
checking bean property types, copying bean properties, etc.
items.translation: JavaBeans 的静态便捷方法：用于实例化 Bean、检查 Bean 属性类型、复制 Bean 属性等。

items.source: The central interface of Spring's low-level JavaBeans infrastructure.
items.translation: Spring 低级 JavaBeans 基础设施的中心接口。

items.source: Interface that encapsulates configuration methods for a PropertyAccessor.
items.translation: 封装了 PropertyAccessor 配置方法的接口。

items.source: Exception thrown when no suitable editor or converter can be found for a bean property.
items.translation: 找不到适合 Bean 属性的编辑器或转换器时抛出异常。

items.source:
Thrown on an unrecoverable problem encountered in the
beans packages or sub-packages, for example, bad class or field.
items.translation: 在 beans 包或其子包中遇到无法恢复的问题时抛出，例如类或字段错误。

items.source: Exception thrown when referring to an invalid bean property.
items.translation: 引用无效的 Bean 属性时抛出异常。

items.source:
Interface representing an object whose value set can be merged with
that of a parent object.
items.translation: 表示其值集可与父对象值集合并的对象接口。

items.source:
Thrown when a bean property getter or setter method throws an exception,
analogous to an InvocationTargetException.
items.translation: 当 Bean 属性的 getter 或 setter 方法抛出异常时抛出，类似于 InvocationTargetException。

items.source:
Exception thrown on an attempt to get the value of a property
that isn't readable, because there's no getter method.
items.translation: 在尝试获取没有 getter 方法的不可读属性的值时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown on an attempt to set the value of a property that
is not writable (typically because there is no setter method).
items.translation: 在尝试设置不可写属性的值时抛出异常（通常是因为没有 setter 方法）。

items.source:
Exception thrown when navigation of a valid nested property
path encounters a NullPointerException.
items.translation: 在导航有效的嵌套属性路径时抛出空指针异常。

items.source:
Superclass for exceptions related to a property access,
such as type mismatch or invocation target exception.
items.translation: 与属性访问相关的异常的超类，例如类型不匹配或调用目标异常。

items.source:
Common interface for classes that can access named properties
(such as bean properties of an object or fields in an object).
items.translation: 可访问命名属性（例如对象的 Bean 属性或字段）的类的通用接口。

items.source: Combined exception, composed of individual PropertyAccessException instances.
items.translation: 组合异常，由多个 PropertyAccessException 实例组成。

items.source:
Helper class for calculating property matches, according to a configurable
distance.
items.translation: 用于根据可配置距离计算属性匹配的辅助类。

items.source: Object to hold information and value for an individual bean property.
items.translation: 用于存储单个 Bean 属性的信息和值的对象。

items.source: Interface that defines type conversion methods.
items.translation: 定义类型转换方法的接口。

items.source: Exception thrown on a type mismatch when trying to set a bean property.
items.translation: 在尝试设置 Bean 属性时，因类型不匹配而抛出异常。
